explanation: Erdős #1204, second part: estimate B(k), the minimum of (a₁ + … + a_k)/k over admissible sequences (missing a residue class mod every prime). Admissibility and minSum are encoded correctly. Since B(k) ≍ k log k already follows from the known bounds on A(k), reading "estimate" as an asymptotic formula is a sensible, documented choice. The statement is faithful and open.
